description: Seeded contradictions. A correct fusion step reports each entry with the listed types.

items.subject: date_of_birth
items.summary: The checkout form collects a date of birth that the privacy notice does not list.

items.subject: meta
items.summary: The privacy notice says data is shared with no one except the payment provider and carrier, yet the checkout sends hashed e-mail, phone and order value to Meta.

items.subject: meta
items.summary: Meta Platforms receives personal data in the United States but is neither declared nor covered by a transfer safeguard.

items.subject: retention
items.summary: The company privacy policy promises deletion after 24 months while the shop keeps orders for seven years.

items.subject: ip_address
items.summary: The notice says IP addresses are shortened before storage, but full addresses are stored and sent to the agency.

items.subject: brightlens
items.summary: BrightLens processes visitor data but no processor agreement is on file.

items.subject: user_email
items.summary: Logged in customers' e-mail addresses are stored as the user id, which the notice and questionnaire do not mention.

items.subject: retention
items.summary: Policy and questionnaire say twelve months after closure, but tickets back to 2022 are retained and no deletion exists.

items.subject: message_content
items.summary: The notice says chat transcripts are not stored, but every message is stored in the messages table.

items.subject: leadscope
items.summary: LeadScope Data receives contact data in India, which has no adequacy decision, and no safeguard is recorded.

items.subject: retention
items.summary: The questionnaire gives no retention period.

items.subject: health_data
items.summary: Health data is processed with no Article 9 condition recorded, and the notice cites legitimate interests.

items.subject: smsgate
items.summary: SMSGate receives phone numbers and appointment times in India with no adequacy decision or safeguard.

items.subject: last_review_date
items.summary: The record was last reviewed on 2023-02-01, more than twelve months before the reference date.

items.subject: phone
items.summary: The subscribe form collects a phone number that the privacy notice does not list.

items.subject: marketing_consent
items.summary: The marketing consent box is ticked by default although the notice promises an active opt in.

items.subject: openpulse
items.summary: OpenPulse Tracking receives hashed subscriber e-mails in the United States; it is undeclared, has no safeguard and no agreement.

items.subject: sentry
items.summary: The desktop app sends staff e-mail, device id and IP address to Sentry, which is undeclared, has no safeguard and no agreement.

items.subject: special_categories
items.summary: Disability, trade union and ethnic origin data are collected with no Article 9 condition recorded.
